import json

def solve_lines(g, coord):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # collect line colors: coordinate -> color (must be consistent)
    linecol={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]:
                c=coord(i,j)
                if c in linecol and linecol[c]!=g[i][j]: return None
                linecol[c]=g[i][j]
    p=len(linecol)
    return [[linecol[coord(i,j)%p] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
